patterns.note: Alternating full-width image sections with product grid sections, creating a varied visual rhythm down the page and breaking up content blocks.

Rich, deep, and often saturated background colors (e.g., dark red, olive green, mustard yellow) are used for full sections, providing a strong visual identity and high contrast for product displays and text.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established using an elegant serif font for prominent headings and a clean sans-serif for body text and smaller labels, conveying a sense of luxury and readability.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, ensuring constant access to site links and brand identity.
Editorial-style image sections are interspersed throughout the page, featuring artfully arranged products and models, often with minimal text, to convey brand aesthetic and quality.

technique_notes: To achieve the rich visual sections, use full-bleed background images or solid color blocks, often with subtle textures or gradients, to frame product photography or editorial content.

Implement a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the viewport on scroll, ensuring navigation is always accessible. Additionally, a full-screen modal overlay appears on initial page load, centered with a prominent call to action, and is dismissible by the user.
Product displays are structured in flexible grids, allowing for varying numbers of items per row, often with a title and price below each item, presented on a clean background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant serif headings are significantly larger (~3-4x body text) and often set in title case, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and image containers, maintaining a sophisticated and soft edge without being overtly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with generous vertical spacing between major sections, creating an airy feel, while product grids maintain a tighter, consistent rhythm.

standout: The site's standout feature is its highly curated, editorial-style photography and rich, painterly color palette that elevates product presentation beyond typical e-commerce. Each section feels like a page from a luxury magazine, emphasizing artistry and quality.
